expected.note: CARA's unadjusted methods use |r| (including the component along the relative velocity) as the in-plane miss distance. Sentinel uses the in-plane miss at the refined TCA. Reproducing CARA's convention must match to rtol.

tolerance.justification: Same Gaussian, same disk, same convention: only quadrature error remains
